entradas.text: "Tell me, Mr. President. What are your real intentions?"
"I'm trying not to lose the support of the people. This is their will."
entradas.menu: "I'm trying not to lose the support of the people. This is their will."

entradas.text: "I know that I can't do a lot. But I'm doing my best to start the change."
entradas.menu: "I know that I can't do a lot. But I'm doing my best to start the change."

entradas.text: "I only want a strong Sordland."
entradas.menu: "I only want a strong Sordland."

entradas.text: "We need a better democracy. That's all I'm striving for."
entradas.menu: "We need a better democracy. That's all I'm striving for."

entradas.text: "I see your intentions but this is not the way forward."
"The threshold is what keeps the extremist parties outside the Assembly."
entradas.menu: "The threshold is what keeps the extremist parties outside."

entradas.text: "The Assembly is the most democratic institution that we have."
entradas.menu: "The Assembly is the most democratic institution that we have."

entradas.text: She smiled a little.
"But what happens when they have no checks on them?"
"So is that your intention after all? Bringing parliamentary democracy to Sordland?"
"You are giving the Assembly all the authority with this proposal with no checks and balances."
"That's not really convincing, is it?"
"We must eventually transform into the parliamentary system."
entradas.menu: "We must eventually transform into the parliamentary system."

entradas.text: "Better democracy by eliminating the Justices whenever you want? By binding the Court to the Assembly to do their bidding?"
"The Constitution must be respected."
"I don't see how this proposal democratizes anything."
"I completely disagree with that. Not all decisions made by the majority are supposed to be respected."
"The MP's are elected. If they have a majority, then we must respect that decision."
entradas.menu: "The MP's are elected. If they have a majority, then we must respect that decision."

entradas.text: "For some reason, I doubt that."
"I think that era is closing. We have many popular parties now."
entradas.menu: "I think that era is closing. We have many popular parties now."

entradas.text: "You are right to have concerns. But this is the way forward."
entradas.menu: "You are right to have concerns. But this is the way forward."

entradas.text: "...But let's say this proposal goes through..."
"Starting a change by eliminating the Justices whenever you want? Is this the change?"
"There are still checks and balances."
entradas.menu: "There are still checks and balances."

entradas.text: "I see."
"Strong? You are weakening both the executive and the judiciary."
"I don't see any in this proposal."
"I don't see how this proposal helps with that."
"Maybe you are right about that. But I still don't think if this proposal would help with that."
"Then why would you not include a decrease in our election threshold that everybody outside of your own party finds ridiculous?"
"I like your honesty, Mr. President."
"Oh yes. People wanted the Supreme Court Justices to be impeached by the Assembly whenever they want."
"Maybe you only care about a certain part of the population, Mr. President."
"Not my intention. But if there is demand, we must consider it."
entradas.menu: "Not my intention. But if there is demand, we must consider it."

entradas.text: "But this will also result in the same, Mr. President. What happens if a party holds an absolute majority in the Assembly?"
"I am sure this is what takes up everybody's mind."
"I guess it's a fitting description."
"I don't find it believable."
"Interesting. But I am not sure if this proposal would help with that."
"Is that what you call it?"
"Is the elective dictatorship we have is better?"
entradas.menu: "Is the elective dictatorship we have is better?"

entradas.text: "Of course it's not your intention."
"I thought you would agree to that. I believed that respectable Justices like you are against the Old Guard."
entradas.menu: "I thought you would agree to that. I believed that respectable Justices like you are against the Old Guard."

entradas.text: "It depends on the circumstances."
entradas.menu: "It depends on the circumstances."

entradas.text: "This will pave the way for a parliamentary democracy."
entradas.menu: "This will pave the way for a parliamentary democracy."

entradas.text: "How? This is an attack against the Court..."
"Look. I am in opposition to them and definitely stand against their dominance. But this is not the way."
"Yes. We must eventually decrease the threshold."
entradas.menu: "Yes. We must eventually decrease the threshold."

entradas.text: "Yes. That is the future for Sordland."
entradas.menu: "Yes. That is the future for Sordland."

entradas.text: "I see."
"Is that one of your intentions then?"
"Why did you include that in the proposal, knowing that you need our vote?"
"I thought the Court could see reason."
entradas.menu: "I thought the Court could see reason."

entradas.text: "What a convincing answer, Mr. President."
"I think the presidential system is what damaged our republic."
entradas.menu: "I think the presidential system is what damaged our republic."

entradas.text: "The proposal doesn't contain any democratic reforms about the elections, decrees nor the minister procedures."
"I don't think this is the right time for such reform. It can create a political crisis."
entradas.menu: "I don't think this is the right time for such reform. It can create a political crisis."

entradas.text: "I actually agree with that. We can't let the Malenyevist nor separatist parties to enter the Assembly."
"That can be addressed later."
entradas.menu: "That can be addressed later."

entradas.text: "You can't just throw words like that."
"Sometimes that's the sad reality. I need to care for myself and the party too."
entradas.menu: "Sometimes that's the sad reality. I need to care for myself and the party too."

entradas.text: "Well, that's true to some extent. Don't get me wrong, I am not against the current threshold."
"The Assembly has long been overshadowed. They need all the power to make laws."
entradas.menu: "The Assembly has long been overshadowed. They need all the power to make laws."

entradas.text: "That's not my intention but my hope for the future."
entradas.menu: "That's not my intention but my hope for the future."

entradas.text: "I don't agree with this."
"I've had to take my chances. We need it to clean up the Old Guard."
entradas.menu: "I've had to take my chances. We need it to clean up the Old Guard."

entradas.text: "Perhaps this proposal is only making you stronger. And a little too strong at that."
"Oh yes. People wanted to make you king."
